title: Are You a Snowbird or Snow Bunny?
main_content:
Winters in parts of the United States can be cold and, at times, snowy.

When a heavy snow blankets an area, it turns everything magical.

It turns a dirty city into a winter wonderland overnight. A blanket of snow softens a city’s hard edges. It quiets loud noises.

Many people love a big snowstorm, such as snow bunnies.

Snow bunnies are not cute little animals.

A snow bunny is a young, female skier.

But many people do not like the cold and snow.

In fact, some Americans dislike cold weather so much they go to a warmer climate to escape it. These people are called snowbirds.

Snowbirds are like some birds, in that they move to warmer climates in the winter months.

So now when you hear someone use the words snowbird and snow bunny you will know they are not talking about woodland creatures.

questions.question: How would you call a young female skier?
What do snowbirds do?
options: They build nests in cold weather

questions.question: What can snow do to a dirty city overnight?
options: It can make it more polluted
It can transform it into a winter wonderland
questions.answer: It can transform it into a winter wonderland
